review_text: Such a great experience! This was my first time working in a co-working space. Since the internet connection in our area was unreliable, I searched for co-working spaces nearby. What I was really looking for was a place where I could take Zoom meetings without distractions—and it was perfect because they had private pods where I could have peace of mind and focus on my work. The package was also very affordable. The staff were very accommodating, and I really appreciated the little details: ✅ You can bring food inside ✅ Fast and stable internet ✅ Clean and secure environment I can recommend this establishment🫡

I have been here multiple times since reviewing for licensure exams and the service keeps getting better. Thank you, Work Co for providing a good and comfortable co-working space! Will definitely always recommend to others - Krezel
